commit_title: Add blocky Hero Swim-first morphology family (0.25.64)
summary: Hero / Swim-first now has a blocky newly evolved form and nine mature signed-axis forms: balanced, Run, Power, Fly, Swim, Run + Fly, Run + Swim, Power + Fly and Power + Swim. The original 7 x 6 x 6 head box and all nine earlier gameplay models remain unchanged. Adult Hero alignment and first Swim type stay locked when later training crosses balance. Full build passed, all 578 required dedicated-server tests passed, and one final client invocation completed 94 cases with 802 unchanged captures. The report includes 90 matched actual viewer/game pairs and 27 additional Minecraft left views.
limitations: Two-piece block arches and blunt caps approximate source curves. Swim streamers are somewhat compressed; the tiny Run + Fly upturn, webbed toes, zigzag edges and fine gradients are simplified. Common fresh geometry and paired-training timing are authored approximations.

The separate inherited journal check remains 8/9: Your gardens paragraph formatting fails on unchanged prior content. It is separate from the successful full Gradle build and all 578 required server tests.
The client used development outputs. All 8,358 production class and asset entries match the frozen snapshot and delivered JAR; this does not mean runClient loaded the archive.

Review covers selected stills and decoded recording samples, not continuous playback or audio listening. Physical touch, a second remote client, dedicated-server world restart and an authentic historical world were not tested.

Water coverage is a stationary swimming pose. Actual Accessories carrying is stationary upright Creative flight; the player hides the front and partly occludes or overlaps the face/halo. Autonomous swimming/gliding and horizontal equipped travel were not tested.

Entity NBT round-trips, encoded tracked observer updates and actual GUI/server editing paths were tested. Natural first evolution was seeded near its threshold and ticked through the real cocoon, rather than testing a full natural lifetime. See the report for precise scopes and suggested in-game follow-up.
